svg.title: OKHWB regular triangle palette: 1024 colors
svg.desc: 48 hue triangles with 21 colored samples and a repeated shared 16-gray boundary. Cells indicate coordinate regions, not perceptual distance.

g.text: 48 hues × 21 colored samples + 16 shared grays · W / B increments of 1/6

svg.text: Gray edge shown on each slice for orientation; its colors occur only once in the palette.
